messages.content: Welcome to the Kalrav 2026 server. Tech team works in #dev; registrations and payments questions go to #payments.
Hi all, I'm leading tech for FestFlow this year. For anything tech, mail meera@festflow.dev or ping @meera_k here.
Treasurer here. The budget sheet is with Prof. Rao and me, ask if you need numbers.
Is there a FestFlow app or just the website?
Just the website, it works on phones. The gate scanner is a separate PWA for volunteers.
Logo v2 for Kalrav 2026 is up on Figma, feedback by Friday please
looks great, the orange works on dark too
Event list for Kalrav 2026 is final: 41 events across 3 days. Coordinators, send descriptions to Sana by 8 Feb.
FestFlow moved to Render today. Site URL stays the same: festflow.dev
When do registrations open? Juniors keep asking in the hostel groups
Registrations open 1 March. Early-bird pass is ₹299 till 31 March, then ₹399.
registration page still says coming soon
opens tomorrow 9am
@everyone Registrations for Kalrav 2026 are OPEN on festflow.dev. Early-bird ₹299 till 31 March.
site is super slow from hostel wifi, is it just me?
we're seeing a spike, should settle. Try mobile data if it's stuck
Registrations after day 1: 812!
Excellent. Keep the momentum.
a lot of people say they never got the login email
Known issue with our auth provider limits, we're on it. Ask them to retry after 30 minutes.
Login is fixed. We moved to a new auth provider, so if you signed up earlier just use 'Sign in with email' again with the same address.
Team events: max 6 members per team, confirmed by the committee.
Ticket design is final, sneak peek in #dev
I paid twice for Battle of Bands, what do I do?
DM me your registration ID, we'll refund the duplicate. Fix is going out this week.
Last day of early-bird! ₹399 from tomorrow.
posters going up in all hostels this week
@everyone Registrations for Kalrav 2026 close on 28 April. Spread the word in your hostels.
site countdown still says 25 April, which one is right?
+1, people are asking
Reminder: volunteers for gate check-in, register with Kabir by 20 April. You'll use your own phone.
Sponsor logos will be on tickets and the website footer from next week
volunteer form filled, got the scanner link
Fest dates are 30 April to 2 May. No changes.
can we get a QR on the poster that opens the registration page?
festflow.dev/r works, it redirects to registration
Meera graduates next month; Arjun Mehta takes over as tech lead from May. Please loop him in on everything.
Thanks Prof! Ping me for anything FestFlow from now.
can we still get refunds if we can't come? asking for a friend
Refund requests are open till 20 April as per the policy, sorry
Pass prices for the poster: ₹399 single, team events as listed?
yes, team events are priced per team not per head
Repo is up: github.com/festflow-club/festflow. npm workspaces: apps/web, apps/api, apps/scanner, services/email-templates.
cloned, running
Auth plan: we use Firebase Authentication, Google sign-in + email link. Free tier should be fine for us.
Firebase is easy on the web side, I'll do the login page
event pages up on local, PR soon
API verifies Firebase ID tokens now. Use the emulator for local dev.
Ticket email mock is in Figma under 'Kalrav tickets'
nice, I'll build it in MJML this week
team registration endpoints done, need a review
on it
Build fails on Windows for me: 'copy-templates.sh' is not recognized. Anyone?
that script is bash. Use Git Bash or WSL for now, I'll make it cross-platform later
WSL works. opened #31 so we don't forget
scanner PWA shell is up, camera works on Android Chrome
pushed brand colours, the orange is #F26B1D
Gmail SMTP is throttling us at ~100 mails/day. Moving email to Resend.
Resend is live for all FestFlow mail. PR #29.
notes from today's sync are in docs/meeting-notes
Render blueprint is in. Moving web + api off Vercel this week, the hobby plan doesn't allow selling tickets.
Done. web and api are on Render, Postgres too. Vercel project paused.
who has the Render login? I want to see logs
I'll add you to the team. Logs are under the api service.
team size limit is a per-event config now, default 6
Build fails on Windows again after pulling main, now it's the mjml step
same script. WSL please, sorry
fixed the iOS Safari camera prompt, it needs a user tap before getUserMedia
team invite flow is merged
email templates now embed Noto Sans so Marathi names render in Gmail
offline check-in queue in IndexedDB, syncs when online (PR #58)
reminder: PRs need one approval from me before merge, even small ones
QR payload is now ticketId.signature with HMAC-SHA256 (PR #66). Old test tickets won't scan.
scanner verifies the HMAC offline now. It needs TICKET_SIGNING_SECRET in the scanner build, is that ok?
not ideal, anyone who extracts it from the PWA can mint tickets. OK for this fest, we move to Ed25519 signatures next year.
here's the internal api key for the admin desk so you can test: FFK_API_KEY=ffk_live_9fQ2xR7mKp4Lw8ZtB3vN6cYh
@kabir_s please don't paste keys in Discord. Deleting this, I'll rotate it.
oops sorry
early-bird pricing window is configurable now, ends 31 Mar 23:59 IST
Firebase is rejecting email-link sends, we've hit the daily quota on the free tier. Sign-ups are piling up.
Blaze plan needs a card and the college can't do that fast
Prototyping Supabase auth on a branch. Magic link + Google, the free tier gives 50k MAU.
Firebase free tier hit limits during fest sign-ups again, ~200 people stuck at the email link screen. Moving auth to Supabase today, PR #84.
reviewing #84 now
LGTM, tested Google + magic link locally
Merged. Auth is on Supabase now. Imported 1,912 Firebase users. Firebase project is read-only.
login copy updated for magic link
REGISTRATION_CLOSES_AT=2026-04-25T23:59+05:30 is set on Render, countdown is live on the home page
max 6 members per team enforced in the API
Build fails on Windows on my laptop too, I just wanted to change the ticket colours
@sana.designs send me the colours, I'll push it. The template build needs bash.
opened #63 anyway
event list cached for 60s, home page is much faster
fixed the wrong venue in ticket emails for Block C events, resent 64 tickets
sponsor footer placeholder is in, real logos once Dev confirms sponsors
reminder emails (T-3 days) template done, scheduling next
payment adapter interface is in apps/api/src/payments, Razorpay first
Razorpay test mode webhook verified with signature check
scanner shows sync status now: green synced, amber queued
hi, new volunteer here, trying to set up the repo
Build fails on Windows with 'bash' is not recognized
use WSL, it's a known thing (#31). There was a PR to fix it with shx but it broke the mac build
refund requests list in the admin desk, PR #95 is up
bumped mjml to 4.15, snapshot tests updated
k6 script is in tests/load. First run tonight.
300 rps on registration: p95 2.8s, DB CPU at 95% on the Render free instance. Not good.
we need the paid Postgres plan anyway, the free one expires on 27 April. Dev has to approve the spend.
idempotency key on payment create is merged, no more double registrations
reminder job runs as a Render cron at 9am IST daily
added an index on registrations(event_id, status). p95 now 640ms at 300 rps.
@meera_k where is the prod database password? I need to run a migration
will DM you tonight
feature freeze is on. Only bug fixes from now, each needs a reviewer.
the reminder job sent duplicate mails yesterday because a deploy overlapped the cron. Fixed with a lock.
domain renewal reminder for festflow.dev came to me again, it renews in June
Started HANDOVER.md, filling it in this week
thanks, can you also write down where all the accounts are? Render, Supabase, Resend, Cloudflare
yes, adding it to the list
sponsor logos are in the footer, the ticket email has the strip too
should I run the load test again after the paid DB upgrade?
yes, once Dev approves it
Starting this channel for gateway stuff. We need UPI for sure, most students won't use cards.
Also needs signed webhooks and refunds through the API. I wrote the requirements in architecture.md
Reminder: all fees go to the club account at the SBI campus branch, no personal UPI collections
Opening accounts with Razorpay and PhonePe PG this week to compare fees
Razorpay: 2% per transaction, setup fee ₹0 on the standard plan, but they want the club's PAN and a cancelled cheque
PhonePe PG: 1.8% on UPI, but a one-time setup fee of ₹2,999
Razorpay docs are way better, their test mode is instant
Whichever we pick, the webhook secret goes in the Render env only, never in chat.
Until we pick a gateway, the Pay button stays behind PAYMENTS_ENABLED=false. Early-bird registrations are marked payment pending.
ok, I'll collect cash at the desk for anyone who wants to pay in the meantime
Committee wants the gateway decided by early April
Cash collected at the desk so far: 37 passes. I'll reconcile after the gateway is live.
Seeing duplicate registrations when people double-click Pay in test mode. Opened #44.
I'll take it, it's a small change to the payment create endpoint.
Decision from today's meeting: Razorpay, lower setup fee. Starting KYC.
Starting Razorpay integration tonight. Orders API + webhook.
Razorpay orders + webhook working in test mode. Need live keys once KYC is done.
KYC update: Razorpay wants the club registration certificate, asked Prof. Rao for it
The club certificate is with the Dean's office, I'll get a copy by next week
Refund flow in the admin desk is up for review, PR #95. Refund cutoff is configurable, defaulting to 15 April like architecture.md
Trello says 20 April for refunds btw, I told people 20
ok, leaving it configurable, someone decide
test mode refunds work end to end on Razorpay
Razorpay KYC still pending, they rejected the bank proof once
If KYC isn't done by 25 April we can't take payments at all. Need a backup.
PhonePe trial creds came today, testing this week
wait, didn't we finalise Razorpay on 2 Apr?
we did, but if KYC doesn't clear we need something
PhonePe adapter is behind the PAYMENT_PROVIDER flag, PR #93. Default is still razorpay.
Please don't let both go live, refunds get messy. Someone has to make the call with Prof. Rao.
Webhook URL for both is https://api.festflow.dev/payments/webhook
Still no word from Razorpay. Meeting Prof. Rao tomorrow.
